evidence_spans: For a hydrogen-passivated zigzag graphene nanoribbon with six zigzag chains (Fig. 9a), the agent reports a carbon-to-carbon width of 11.36 Å
hydrogen-passivated zigzag graphene nanoribbon with six zigzag chains
All tool outputs have been validated by comparison with analytic values or with direct pymatgen and spglib calculations
CLM-MAT-0143.statement: The carbon-to-carbon width of the hydrogen-passivated zigzag graphene nanoribbon is 11.36 Å.

extra_quotes: The crystallographic operations of MASON are built on pymatgen [13] and ASE [14], the symmetry analysis uses spglib [27], and the three-dimensional pages are generated with 3Dmol.js [28].
The agent made more than ten tool calls in total, and the researcher provided only the parameters in the request.
